subject: Renewal: prepay commitment + flexible stair-step + co-terming options
messages:
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Chen <sarah.chen@luminexa.com>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@luminexa.com>
Date: 2027-02-15T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Renewal: prepay commitment + flexible stair-step + co-terming options

Hi Sarah —

Great talking this morning. Per our conversation, I put together three practical renewal structures so Luminexa can lock in predictable unit economics while keeping runway flexibility for next year. Attached is a short spreadsheet and a one-page term sheet. Summary below: 

1) 12-month prepay (best price) — Pay for 12 months upfront, 18% discount on per-unit list price, flat usage included (committed units).
2) Staged-commit stair-step — Commit to a 6/12/12 split (year 1/year 2 optional top-up) with blended pricing (12% average discount) and quarterly true-ups. Good for teams expecting stepped growth.
3) Co-term & monthly consumption (flex) — Co-term to 2028-02-28 with a moderate 8% credit for prefunding milestones; consumption billed monthly. Includes burst credit pool and optional priority support.

Key asks from your side:
- If Luminexa can commit to a 12-month prepay, what's the approval window for legal/procurement to return a PO?
- Does Tom need a specific contract language around data residency or audit rights beyond our standard?

If you prefer, we can provide an incremental concession: an additional 3% off on option (1) if Luminexa signs and issues PO within 10 business days.

Next steps: I can loop in Kimberly for commercial approval and Jordan on billing terms if you want a quick call tomorrow to finalize.

Thanks,
David Kim
Senior Manager, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
D: (415) 555-0199
attachments: Luminexa_renewal_options_Q1-2027.xlsx, prepay_term_sheet_v2.pdf
From: Sarah Chen <sarah.chen@luminexa.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@luminexa.com>, legal@luminexa.com
Date: 2027-02-15T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: prepay commitment + flexible stair-step + co-terming options

Hi David —

Thanks for the clear breakdown and the attachments — I reviewed with Tom. A few quick clarifying questions before we run this through procurement/legal: 

- On option (2) the stair-step: can we make the true-up window monthly rather than quarterly? Our finance team likes closer alignment for spend forecasting.
- For option (1) prepay: can you confirm whether the prepay credit is non-refundable and what the invoicing milestone looks like?
- On data residency: we need explicit language confirming logs/audit artifacts will remain in the US region and be available for SOC or compliance review.

Also, we've got a procurement freeze this week but can aim for approvals early next week. If we accept the 10-business-day PO window, will the concession be documented in the SOW or as an amendment?

Appreciate the flexibility — I think we're close.

Best,
Sarah Chen
VP Product Operations
Luminexa
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Chen <sarah.chen@luminexa.com>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@luminexa.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-02-15T13:27:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: prepay commitment + flexible stair-step + co-terming options

Sarah —

Thanks — answers inline below and a couple small updates: 

- Stair-step true-up: fine to move to monthly true-ups. We'll add a monthly reporting cadence and cap quarter-on-quarter true-up at +25% to avoid billing surprises.
- Prepay refundability: prepay is refundable on pro rata basis for unused committed units with a 60-day administrative processing window; refund exceptions for custom-engineered services are noted in the term sheet (we don't have any for your account). Invoicing: standard 30-day net on the invoice generated at signature; payment triggers the prepay credit within billing.
- Data residency: we'll add a clause to the SOW guaranteeing logs/audit artifacts stored in the US region and access for SOC/audit within 10 business days. Our security team okayed the language in draft (I'll attach a short addendum).

Concession: we'll document the additional 3% prepay concession as an amendment to the master services agreement and call it out on the first invoice.

I've looped in Kimberly for commercial approval and Jordan for billing mechanics — Kimberly/Jordan: do you confirm we can offer the 3% early-PO concession and the monthly true-up for stair-step? If yes I'll draft the amendment and send to Sarah and Tom.

Thanks,
David
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-02-15T14:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: prepay commitment + flexible stair-step + co-terming options

David / Jordan —

Quick internal: Approved. Commercial will accept the 3% early-PO concession for a one-time prepay only, must be fully executed and PO received within 10 business days. Monthly true-ups for the stair-step are acceptable; Jordan to ensure billing system can emit monthly credits and cap logic (25% QoQ) without manual reconciliation.

Jordan: please prepare the billing workflow notes and a sample invoice showing the prepay credit applied. I'll sign off on the amendment language once David shares the draft.

K
Kimberly Park
Director, Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Chen <sarah.chen@luminexa.com>

Date: 2027-02-16T15:38:00-08:00
Subject: Final: amendment + next steps (DocuSign & PO timeline)

Hi Sarah / Tom —

Appreciate the quick turn. Per internal confirmation: 
- We will document the extra 3% prepay concession as Amendment A to the MSA; it applies only to option (1) if signed and PO received within 10 business days of amendment execution.
- Stair-step plan revised to monthly true-ups with a 25% QoQ cap; billing will show monthly line-item true-ups and a quarterly summary for bookkeeping.
- Data residency clause and audit access addendum included in attached term sheet (redlines in the PDF).

Next steps: 
1) I uploaded the amendment to DocuSign: https://na1.docusign.net/prepare/ABCDEFG-12345
2) If you approve, please sign and then send PO to invoices@redwoodinference.com referencing DEAL-4821.
3) Jordan will send a sample invoice and billing workflow within 24 hours of signature so your finance team knows the expected format.

If you need an exec skit call to clear anything, I can make time tomorrow morning. Otherwise we look forward to the signed amendment and PO.

Best,
David Kim
Senior Manager, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
